title: The Second Census

questions.question: After the plague, who did God command to take a census?
options: Moses and Eleazar the son of Aaron
questions.correctAnswer: Moses and Eleazar the son of Aaron
questions.explanation: Numbers 26:1 (ESV): "The Lord said to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest..."

questions.question: Who was to be counted in this second census?
options: Every male from twenty years old and upward, able to go to war
questions.correctAnswer: Every male from twenty years old and upward, able to go to war
questions.explanation: Numbers 26:2 (ESV): "Take a census... from twenty years old and upward... all... able to go to war."

questions.question: Which tribe was the largest in this second census?
questions.explanation: Numbers 26:22 (ESV): "The sons of Judah... 76,500." (Compare: Dan 64,400 etc.)

questions.question: Which tribe had decreased significantly (from the first census)?
questions.explanation: Numbers 26:14 (ESV): "The sons of Simeon... 22,200." (Checking ch 1:23 shows 59,300, a huge loss).

questions.question: How was the land to be divided for inheritance?
options: According to the number of names (larger tribes get more)
questions.correctAnswer: According to the number of names (larger tribes get more)
questions.explanation: Numbers 26:53 (ESV): "Among these the land shall be divided... according to the number of names." (Also v54: "To a large tribe... give a large inheritance")

questions.question: Who were Dathan and Abiram mentioned here?
options: Those who contended against Moses and Aaron in the company of Korah
questions.correctAnswer: Those who contended against Moses and Aaron in the company of Korah
questions.explanation: Numbers 26:9 (ESV): "These are the Dathan and Abiram... who contended against Moses... in the company of Korah..."

questions.question: Did the sons of Korah die in the rebellion?
options: No, the sons of Korah did not die
questions.correctAnswer: No, the sons of Korah did not die
questions.explanation: Numbers 26:11 (ESV): "But the sons of Korah did not die."

questions.question: What was the total number of the people of Israel able to go to war?
questions.explanation: Numbers 26:51 (ESV): "This was the list... 601,730." (Slight decrease from 603,550).

questions.question: How many people from the first census (Sinai) were left alive?
options: Not one of them except Caleb and Joshua
questions.correctAnswer: Not one of them except Caleb and Joshua
questions.explanation: Numbers 26:65 (ESV): "For the Lord had said of them, 'They shall die in the wilderness.' Not one of them was left, except Caleb... and Joshua..."

questions.question: How many families of Levites were listed?
questions.explanation: Numbers 26:57 lists the clans of Levi.

questions.question: Who was the mother of Aaron and Moses mentioned here?
questions.explanation: Numbers 26:59 (ESV): "The name of Amram's wife was Jochebed the daughter of Levi..."

questions.question: How was the inheritance location determined?
questions.explanation: Numbers 26:55 (ESV): "But the land shall be divided by lot."

questions.question: Who were the sons of Judah who died in Canaan?
questions.explanation: Numbers 26:19 (ESV): "The sons of Judah were Er and Onan; and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan."

questions.question: Zelophehad had no sons, but only...?
questions.explanation: Numbers 26:33 (ESV): "Now Zelophehad... had no sons, but daughters..."

questions.question: Who were the sons of Manasseh listed?
questions.explanation: Numbers 26:29 (ESV): "The sons of Manasseh: of Machir... and Machir was the father of Gilead..."

key_verse_text: For the Lord had said of them, 'They shall die in the wilderness.' Not one of them was left, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh and Joshua the son of Nun.
